acquisition method: MS data were acquired with a Top15 data-dependent MS/MS scan method (topN method)
cleavage agent: Trypsin and LysC (1:100 μg of enzyme to micrograms of protein ratio) were added to the mixture
collision energy: Fragmentation of precursor ions was performed by higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 27 eV.
enrichment method: depletion of the top 20 most abundant plasma proteins
We built up a matching library and used a depletion of the top 20 most abundant plasma proteins by a combination of two immunodepletion kits
fragmentation method: Fragmentation of precursor ions was performed by higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD)
instrument: combined with a Q Exactive HF Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: combined with a Q Exactive HF Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and a nano-electrospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: Label-free protein quantitation (LFQ) was performed with a minimum ratio count of 1
